title: Evaluating gesture generation in a large-scale open challenge: The GENEA Challenge 2022
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical evaluation and benchmarking of gesture generation models. While it discusses 'human biases' in the context of user study ratings, this refers to biases in perception during evaluation rather than ethical considerations or biases inherent in the AI models or their outputs in a societal or moral sense. There are no dedicated sections or core components evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. The paper is a report on a challenge, not a survey of the field.
